label: Ostrich and moa have passed the size at which muscular flight is possible
statement_en: The ostrich probably, and the moa certainly, reached a size at which flight by muscular action with ordinary bird anatomy became physiologically impossible, and a bird as large as a man could not fly.

hypotheses.name: thompson1917-ch02-07#assumed-1
hypotheses.statement: Everything in thompson1917-ch02-06, and that the family extends to the size in question with unchanged proportions.

hypotheses.name: thompson1917-ch02-07#assumed-2
hypotheses.statement: The value of L* needs f, p, L/D, ρ and C_L,max; the proof supplies none, so nothing here places the ostrich, the moa or a man-sized bird above it.

scope.basis: a theorem about a model: it applies wherever the design supplies the quantities it uses and accepts the hypotheses in scope.assumed
kernelChecked: Under R1, R2, constant ρ, C_L,max, L/D and MusclePowerLaw there is a size L* > 0 such that for every L > L*, P_avail(L) < P_req(L) at v_min (exists_size_limit, with L* = 1/c² for the explicit c of powerRatio_eq).
